task_protocol_findings.finding: Original task common instructions used TNN.yv/TNN.rs, while the instrumented runner requires main.yv/main.rs within each task directory.
task_protocol_findings.observed_resolution: COMMON and generated TASKS.md now specify independent per-task directories with main.yv/main.rs; T04 adds a module in that directory.

task_protocol_findings.finding: T01 originally bounded all balances at 10^9, but the large-sums hidden case produces a current balance of 3*10^9.
task_protocol_findings.observed_resolution: Task now bounds only initial balances and transfer amounts at 10^9 and permits larger post-transfer balances.

task_protocol_findings.observed_resolution: Common statement explicitly excepts T12 comparison-only numeric PRE identifiers.

historical_task_overlap.packet: Twelve newly specified programs, not twelve wholly unseen task families or a strict family holdout.

reused_families.new_requirements: Atomic batch rollback and consumption, sequential credit, new self-transfer rule.
Three actual OS workers, prescribed contiguous chunks, ordered merging across boundaries.
Expiry before each operation, zero TTL deletion, overwrite renewal, get without renewal.

oracle_review.current_observation: No computational mismatch identified in reviewed money/decimal parsing, CSV, TTL LRU, path normalization, escaped glob or version ordering logic.

independent_glob_check.method: Independently tokenize escapes, reject a final unmatched backslash, then propagate prefix-match states. A star reaches all text prefixes at or after a currently reachable prefix; a question mark or matching literal advances one byte. Compare acceptance or invalidity with generate.py glob_regex plus re.fullmatch.

frozen_case_regeneration_agreement.method: For every frozen case, recompute stdout using the corresponding current ORACLES function and compare to stored expected stdout.

oracle_review.limitations: Review and bounded checks do not prove all possible task inputs correct. Frozen-case regeneration checks internal consistency, not an independently derived expected output for every case.

runner_findings.finding: Initial lab interface did not enforce T01..T12 submission order or require a public run for a successfully built submitted version.
Initial stdout/stderr capture was unbounded and read complete files into JSON; runaway output could exhaust storage or memory and lose event finalization.
Initial public judgment compared UTF-8 decoded strings with replacement, rather than exact bytes; malformed output could alias a replacement character.
Initial freeze covered yavo, runtime header, toolchain lock, rustc and linker wrapper, but not the actual Zig executable or Rust sysroot components.

Initial build path increments attempt count and snapshots before verifying entry existence. An interface-error first request must remain a failed first attempt and must not disappear from denominators merely because it has no compiler exit-code record.

freeze_status: Controller must finish runner checks and freeze final hashes before participant dispatch; this receipt is not a final runner acceptance or a completed experiment.
